panels.title: Resources: each Cloud Run service's CPU, memory, instances, concurrency and start-up
No disk on a Cloud Run service

options.content: **Cloud Run services have no disk.** A file a container writes is held in its memory, so a service's "disk space" is its **Memory** chart: files that grow show as memory climbing to the red line, then as a container killed for memory. Real disk is on the databases (each one's disk space is on its area's page and on Databases) and in the buckets. A **red line** is the line the pager uses (tpa-platform's alert policies); a **grey line** is a limit the service is set to.

panels.title: Resources · crm-web: CPU, memory, instances, concurrency, start-up
CPU (p99, p95, p50)
panels.description: crm-web's container CPU, the share of its CPU limit in use (`container/cpu/utilizations`): the 99th, 95th and 50th percentile across its instances in each 5-minute window. The red line is `run-cpu-high`'s: the p99 above 90% for 15 minutes pages (instances saturated: requests queue and slow).

links.title: crm-web: CPU, memory, instances, concurrency, start-up

panels.title: Memory (p99, p95, p50)
panels.description: crm-web's container memory, the share of its memory limit in use (`container/memory/utilizations`), percentiles across its instances in each 5-minute window. Cloud Run has no disk: files the container writes are held in memory and count here. The red line is `run-memory-high`'s: the p99 above 90% for 10 minutes pages; at the limit the container is killed (`run-oom`, the last panel of this row).

panels.title: Instances (active, idle)
panels.description: crm-web's Cloud Run instances, the most in each interval: active (serving or starting) and idle (kept warm, or waiting to be shut down). The grey line is max_instances, 2 on beta (too few for a `ceiling-` policy): at it new requests wait or fail with 429.

panels.title: Concurrent requests, busiest instance (p99, p50)
panels.description: The most requests one instance served at once (`container/max_request_concurrencies`), its 99th and 50th percentile in each 5-minute window. The red line is `run-concurrency-high`'s: the p99 above 71.5 (90% of 80) for 15 minutes pages. The grey line is the concurrency setting, 80: past it a request waits for a slot or a new instance.

panels.title: Start-up time (p99, p50)
panels.description: How long a new instance took to start, until it was ready to serve (`container/startup_latencies`): a dot for each interval in which one started. Nothing drawn: no instance started. No policy reads it; a start-up that failed is the last panel.

panels.title: Instances billed
panels.description: Billable instance time per second (`container/billable_instance_time`): how many instances were billed on average. An instance kept warm with CPU always on bills all the time; one that scales to zero, only while it serves.

panels.title: Killed for memory, crashed, failed to start
panels.description: From Cloud Run's own system log: a container killed for exceeding its memory limit (`run_oom_kills`; `run-oom` pages on one), a container that exited with an error or a signal (`run_crash_exits`; `run-crash-loop` at three in fifteen minutes), and a failed start-up or liveness probe (`run_system_errors`; `canary-startup`).

panels.title: crm-db (the CRM; the app project in beta): disk space, CPU, memory, connections, disk I/O
Disk space used (%)
panels.description: How full crm-db's disk is (`database/disk/utilization`), the mean of each 5 minutes. The red line is `crm-db-disk`'s: above 85% for 10 minutes pages. Automatic storage increase grows the disk before it fills, up to the instance's disk_autoresize_limit; at that limit a full disk stops the database taking writes. "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

panels.title: Disk space: used and size (bytes)
panels.description: crm-db's disk in bytes: used (`database/disk/bytes_used`) and its size (`database/disk/quota`). When the size steps up, Cloud SQL's automatic storage increase grew the disk; it grows only up to disk_autoresize_limit. The dashed red line is 85% of the size, where `crm-db-disk` opens.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Cloud SQL's `database/up` for crm-db, the lowest in each interval. `crm-db-down` (urgent) pages below 1 for five minutes. "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cloud SQL's CPU utilisation for crm-db (`database/cpu/utilization`). The red lines are the monitoring module's: `crm-db` CPU above 80% for thirty minutes, and above 95% for fifteen (urgent).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Cloud SQL's memory utilisation for crm-db (`database/memory/utilization`). The red line is the monitoring module's: above 90% for fifteen minutes; past it PostgreSQL's out-of-memory killer restarts the server.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Backends connected (num_backends, every database of the instance). The red lines are the monitoring module's: 80% of max_connections for ten minutes, and 95% for five (urgent); max_connections is 200 on beta, the grey line, where new connections are refused.

panels.title: Disk operations per second
panels.description: crm-db's disk reads and writes per second (`database/disk/read_ops_count`, `write_ops_count`). Reads near none are normal: the working set is in memory.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes crm-db read from and wrote to its disk per second (`database/disk/read_bytes_count`, `write_bytes_count`).

panels.title: Restarts and failed backups
panels.description: Postgres starting (`sql_restarts`: a crash, a maintenance or a resize restart) and an automated backup whose run ended in error (`sql_backup_failures`), counted from Cloud SQL's own logs.

panels.title: The CRM's project: instances against the regional quota
Cloud Run instances, every service
panels.description: Every Cloud Run instance in the CRM's project, summed. The red line is `run-instances-near-quota`'s: above 68 for 10 minutes pages. The grey line is the regional quota, 85: at it no service can start another instance, whatever its own ceiling. In beta the CRM runs in the app project, so every app service counts here too.

panels.title: crm-db
panels.description: Cloud SQL's own signals for crm-db: `database/up` (the urgent `crm-db-down` pages below 1 for five minutes) and disk used (`crm-db-disk` at 85% for ten minutes). "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

panels.title: CRM job executions
panels.description: The CRM's migration and made-up data seed, each run by a person. A failure opens `jobs-failed` (`crm-jobs-failed` in beta).
